business_rules.text: Image Orientation Fix (EXIF): Before upload the bitmap is re-oriented from its EXIF metadata so the server-side copy matches the device's capture orientation.
IO Dispatcher for Repository Work: Network / disk work is hopped off the main thread via Dispatchers.IO to keep the UI responsive.
Empty Collection Fallback: Null / missing collections are defaulted to an empty list so downstream UI code never has to null-check.
Content-Type Conversion for Upload: Image uploads build a MediaType tagged with an image/* content type so the multipart body is typed correctly for the server.
LiveData Post-to-Main: Background-thread results are delivered to observers via postValue so the emit lands on the main thread.
Account Data Caching: Account list is cached locally to avoid repeated API calls
File Upload Media Type: Profile picture uploads must use image/* media type
Module Registration Order: All required modules must be registered in specific order during application initialization
ViewModel Dependency Injection: ViewModels must be registered with proper dependency resolution using Koin get() calls
Test Application Context: Test runner must use actual application class for proper dependency injection during testing
IO Dispatcher for Repository Work: Network / disk work is hopped off the main thread via Dispatchers.IO to keep the UI responsive.
LiveData Post-to-Main: Background-thread results are delivered to observers via postValue so the emit lands on the main thread.
Account Selection Priority: Always uses the first account from retrieved accounts list for transactions
Current Month Default: ViewPager starts at current calendar month plus one
Loading State Management: Loading state is set to true when fetching new month data
Error State Display: Errors are displayed in place of empty list with custom message
Permission Gating: Camera and storage permissions required before profile picture capture
API Authentication: All API calls must include Bearer token authorization using API_KEY
Content Type Standardization: All API calls must accept application/json except image uploads which use image/jpeg
Network Logging: All HTTP requests and responses must be logged at BODY level
IO Dispatcher for Repository Work: Network / disk work is hopped off the main thread via Dispatchers.IO to keep the UI responsive.
Empty Collection Fallback: Null / missing collections are defaulted to an empty list so downstream UI code never has to null-check.
LiveData Post-to-Main: Background-thread results are delivered to observers via postValue so the emit lands on the main thread.
Null-Bang (!!) Operator: Code uses the force-unwrap (!!) operator, which throws NullPointerException when the left-hand side is null — a latent defect surface worth auditing.
Default Account Badge Display: Shows default badge only when account has defaultAccount flag set to true
Error Response Fallback: Returns default error when API error body cannot be parsed
Network Error Handling: Returns empty list when network call fails during payee retrieval
Authorization Header Requirement: All API calls must include Bearer token authorization header
Parent Behavior Preservation: All parent AppCompatButton functionality must be preserved when overriding methods
Constructor Delegation: All constructor variants must delegate to parent AppCompatButton constructors
